paragraphs: ViaPath Technologies sells technology to correctional facilities, aimed at helping them operate more safely and effectively. The people it serves are incarcerated and formerly incarcerated individuals, their families, and the corrections sector.

The product line covers phones, tablets, video, digital mail, and payments. Alongside it sits a security and intelligence layer built on AI-driven threat detection across calls, messages, and digital activity. There are also programs and training tools meant to prepare incarcerated individuals for employment after release. The company frames the whole of it as an effort to reduce recidivism through reentry support, facility management, and reliable communication.

ViaPath is headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, and says it supports over 2,300 correctional facilities across North America, the UK, and Australia. Its home page claims more than 30 years providing offender management solutions and over a million global users. The stated offering spans secure digital communications, educational tools, payment processing, and data intelligence.

quote.text: Our mission is to help reduce recidivism by providing technology that promotes reentry success, efficient facility management, and secure, reliable communication.
